description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


# Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.4.4

- Pin a live view of a window, now also on macOS, and manage multiple pinned images together. / 支持窗口实时贴图，现已覆盖 macOS，并可批量管理贴图。
- Crop pinned images, pin images after editing, and hide other pins with a shake. / 贴图支持裁剪，编辑后的图片可直接贴图，摇一摇可隐藏其他贴图。
- Add bracket annotations with snapping and measure with more distance units. / 新增支持吸附的括号标注及更多距离单位。
- Open images for annotation from configurable Windows File Explorer menus. / 可配置 Windows 文件资源管理器菜单，直接打开图片进行标注。
- Translate into Hindi, Thai, and Vietnamese; enjoy clearer tooltips and more reliable capture, recording controls, and updates. / 翻译新增印地语、泰语和越南语，优化工具提示、截图、录屏控制及更新体验。

## Quick macOS install / macOS 快速安装

Run in Terminal without `sudo`; append `--edition mini` for Mini. / 复制到终端运行，无需添加 `sudo`；末尾添加 `--edition mini` 可安装 Mini。

```sh
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.4.4_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh
```

The installer verifies and locally signs the app. Grant Screen Recording and Accessibility when prompted. For Gitee downloads, replace `https://github.com` with `https://gitee.com` in the command and download links. / 安装器会校验并本机签名，请按提示授予屏幕录制及辅助功能权限；使用 Gitee 下载时，将命令及下载链接中的 `https://github.com` 替换为 `https://gitee.com`。
